jobs.occupation: Europe Office Manager & HR Liaison M/W/X
jobs.description:
The Europe Office & HR Liaison serves as a key operational partner to the European Managing Director and supports the effective functioning of the Brussels office. This role coordinates office operations, provides administrative and business support, facilitates communication across teams, and helps ensure local priorities and initiatives are executed effectively.

The position also serves as a liaison between Brussels-based employees, HQ Human Resources, and external service providers, supporting a positive employee experience and efficient workplace operations.

This is a highly varied position requiring the ability to manage a broad range of operational, administrative, employee-facing, and business support responsibilities based on evolving organizational needs.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities 

Office Operations & Business Support (70%)

• Coordinate the day-to-day operations of the Brussels office to ensure an efficient, professional, and productive work environment.
• Partner with the European Managing Director to support business priorities, operational initiatives, administrative needs, and special projects.
• Serve as a central point of coordination for workplace operations, facilities, technology, logistics, vendor relationships, and other office support activities.
• Support executive visits, meetings, events, and other business activities requiring local coordination.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration between Brussels-based employees and headquarters teams.
• Support workplace safety, security, business continuity, and employee experience initiatives.
• Perform other related duties and projects in support of organizational objectives.
Human Resources Liaison (30%)

• Serve as the primary local liaison between Brussels-based employees, managers, HQ Human Resources, and external employment partners.
• Support the administration of key employee lifecycle activities, including recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, leave administration, and training.
• Assist managers with policy interpretation, employment practices, and workplace matters, escalating issues as appropriate.
• Support compliance with local employment requirements and coordinate with external employment-related vendors and advisors.
• Facilitate effective communication and collaboration between the Brussels office and HQ Human Resources
Additional Duties

Additional duties as assigned.
 
Minimum Qualifications

Education and/or Experience

• Bachelor's degree (B.A./B.S.) from four-year college or university; and three years of experience related to office management, business operations, human resources, administration, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience
• Strong organizational, communication, and relationship-management skills.
• Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
• Experience coordinating activities across teams and stakeholders.
• Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and sound judgment.
• Knowledge of Belgian employment practices and workplace regulations preferred.
Language Skills

Fluency in English and French and/or Dutch required; additional European languages are a plus. Ability to read and comprehend simple instructions, short correspondence, and memos. Ability to write simple correspondence. Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees.

Additional Information:

The candidate must have the ability and authorization to work in the European Union. They must also have the ability and willingness to travel throughout Europe and the USA. Onboarding and orientation meetings, including training of IAPP tools will be provided.
 
We Offer:

A full-time permanent contract with a competitive salary. Including a full range of benefits (lunch vouchers, Group Insurance, Hospital insurance). Specific training will be provided for the understanding of IAPP tools.

Working at the IAPP is an opportunity like no other. The IAPP offers a creative, supportive and an hybrid work environment. We work in a ¿get-stuff-done¿ culture that values fun, excellence, balance, respect (nice matters!), personal and professional growth, and an entrepreneurial attitude.

For our client, an international company specialized in the management, maintenance and rental of Ground Support Equipment (GSE) for the aviation industry, we are looking for a experienced motivated Welder / Mechanical Assembler. 
As a Welder / Mechanical Assembler, you will be responsible for carrying out welding and metal fabrication work, as well as repairing mechanical components of non-motorized Ground Support Equipment (GSE). You will ensure that all work is performed safely, efficiently and in accordance with technical specifications and quality standards.

Your Responsibilities

• Repair cracks, reinforce structures and manufacture custom metal components. 
 

 
• Assemble and install mechanical parts and components. 
 

 
• Install, adjust and maintain hydraulic and pneumatic systems. 
 

 
• Read and interpret technical drawings and engineering plans. 
 

 
• Carry out inspections and preventive maintenance on welded structures and mechanical components.

jobs.occupation: Electromechanical Technician - motors & machinery | Brucargo | ENG
jobs.description:
For a technical maintenance company operating at the airport, we are looking for a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery. As a Electromechanical Technician – Motors & Machinery, you will be responsible for the maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on a wide range of Ground Support Equipment (GSE), including pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, and other motorized vehicles. You will ensure that all electrical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with current standards.

Your responsibilities include:
 

 
•  
 Performing maintenance, repair, and servicing of electrical systems on GSE equipment (pushback tractors, baggage tractors, belt loaders, GPU units, passenger steps, etc.). 

 
• Troubleshooting and resolving faults in electrical and electronic assemblies. 
 
• Installing, testing, and commissioning electrical systems according to current safety standards and regulations. 
 

 
• Documenting maintenance and repair activities and contributing to technical reports. 
 
•  
Providing on-the-job training to other mechanics on troubleshooting and complex electrical systems. 

 
• Ensuring compliance with legal regulations, safety standards, and quality assurance guidelines. 
 
•  
Keeping tools, equipment, and test devices in good working condition through routine checks and cleaning. 

 
• Preparing equipment for handover to customers or deployment on airport sites. 
 

 
• Coordinating with mechanical, electrical, and workshop technicians to ensure efficient and safe execution of repair and maintenance tasks. 

 
• Completed vocational training as an industrial electrician, electronics technician for industrial engineering, mechatronics technician, or a comparable qualification. 
 
• Extensive experience in the maintenance and repair of electrical systems, ideally in aviation or a related technical field. 
 
• Experience with high voltage equipment, preferably with certification. 
 
• Extensive knowledge of control technology and proficiency in reading circuit diagrams. 
 
• Excellent communication skills to report issues and collaborate with other workshop personnel. 
 
• Good command of local language as well as English language, both spoken and written. 
 
• Class B driving license, additional driving permits are an advantage. 
 
• Possess or are eligible to obtain an airport security pass and an airport driving permit.
